abstract: Guided seven-phase workflow that takes an arbitrary ML codebase to a production-grade open-source MLflow 3 setup: scripted read-only assessment, registry domain modelling, per-environment tracking infrastructure (dev/staging/prod), training-code restructuring to MLflow 3 idioms, evaluation-gated promotion via aliases and copy_model_version, serving with smoke tests, and the ongoing MLOps loop. Companion to the mlflow-3 distillation skill; pinned to mlflow 3.15.1.
